about.size: Common up to about 50 lb; can reach about 100 lb
about.diet: Small fish, crabs and shrimp living in sargassum; also flying fish and mackerels
about.swimming_depth: Epipelagic: surface to about 85 m. Satellite-tagged fish spent about 40% of their time within about 1 m of the surface and made occasional dives to about 250 m.
about.behavior: Offshore, drawn to floating structure (sargassum weedlines, flotsam, floating debris). Moves closer to shore in summer as shelf waters warm.
about.lifespan: About 6 years; fast growing, matures very young
